reconstructed_captions.18: He walks through the forest carrying the basket of clay.
reconstructed_captions.19: He arrives at a clearing and sets his materials down near a large, flat stone.
reconstructed_captions.20: He kneels before the stone, which will be his work surface.
reconstructed_captions.21: He takes a smaller rock and begins to grind it against the large stone.
reconstructed_captions.22: He grinds the rock back and forth, creating a fine powder.
reconstructed_captions.23: A close-up shows the powder accumulating on the dark surface of the stone.
reconstructed_captions.24: He continues grinding to create enough powder for his work.
reconstructed_captions.25: He sets the smaller grinding rock aside.
reconstructed_captions.26: He reaches into the basket and pulls out a large piece of the prepared clay.
reconstructed_captions.27: A hand begins spreading the fine powder across the flat stone.
reconstructed_captions.28: The hand continues to spread the powder to create a non-stick surface.
reconstructed_captions.29: The hand smoothes the powder into a thin, even layer.
